keeper.source: Operator declaration for the D20DAO Arc Testnet keepers during these runs. Not measured by this repository and not verifiable from chain data; the keeper repository is private. The fulfillment submitter of every transaction is recorded from chain data in each result (batching.bySubmitter).

settings.transactionLanes: two lanes: a primary keeper and a backup keeper, each with its own wallet and one nonce lane
settings.pushedBlocks: one public Arc Testnet WebSocket endpoint (wss://rpc.testnet.arc.io) for new blocks and service events; every decision is read over HTTP

backup.role: backup keeper (follower) with its own wallet, authorized on chain as a backup committer
backup.joinRule: prepares and serves from the newest end of the queue when the oldest open request is older than 20 s, the open queue exceeds 150 requests, or the primary has stopped making progress

scenario.name: sequential-20
scenario.description: Baseline: 20 requests, one per transaction; the next request is sent only after the previous one is fulfilled or expired.

latencySeconds.basis: fulfillment block timestamp minus request block timestamp (1 s resolution)

latencyBlocks.basis: fulfillment block number minus request block number

wallClockSeconds.basis: this process: broadcast start to first observation through rpc.blockdaemon.testnet.arc.io, polling every 500 ms

throughput.basis: this run's fulfilled requests divided by the seconds between the first and last fulfillment block timestamps
throughput.limitedBy: arrival rate of this scenario, not keeper capacity

duration.chainBasis: first request block timestamp to last fulfillment block timestamp

user.note: requests opened through LoadConsumer; one request per transaction (sequential) is the closest to a single application request

epochs.basis: targetBlock = max(requestBlock, epoch commit block + 1); a later target means the request waited for its epoch packet to be published

blocks.window: from the chain head when the run started to the last block containing a request or a fulfillment of this run
